g.text: Distance as the cost of moving sand
each document is a handful of small piles standing in meaning space, and turning one into the other means moving the sand
The distance is the total cost
a pile is one statement, standing where its meaning sits
a dashed pile is a place document B has to fill
how thick it is • how much sand moves
how long it is • how far, so what it costs
meaning space • statements that say similar things stand near each other, so a short move is a small change in meaning
a long haul is the expensive move
